trace.question: Among the patients with a normal Ig G level, how many of them have symptoms?
trace.evidence: normal Ig G level refers to IGG > 900 and IGG < 2000; have symptoms refers to Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

attempts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900 AND L.IGG < 2000
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

trace.final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900 AND L.IGG < 2000
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
trace.answer: One patient with a normal IgG level has symptoms.
